app_fee.value: Krieger School of Arts and Sciences (physics, chemistry, math, biology, earth science) charges USD 75 per application.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable fee of $75.00 is required for each application to the Krieger School of Arts and Sciences.

fee_waiver.value: A financial-hardship waiver can be requested in the application, and international applicants are not excluded; some partner-program waivers also exist.
fee_waiver.quote: To request a waiver based on financial hardship please select the option on the application and upload one of the following

gre_general.value: Krieger lets each program decide; see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Many of our graduate programs no longer require submitting GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: Krieger prefers TOEFL iBT 100 or higher (worded as a preference, not a hard cutoff).
toefl_min.quote: Applicants seeking admission who have taken the TOEFL test will preferably have a score of at least 100 for the Internet Based Test

ielts_min.value: Krieger prefers an IELTS Academic band of at least 7 (a preference, not a hard cutoff).
ielts_min.quote: Applicants seeking admission who have taken the IELTS test will preferably have an academic Band Score at least equal to 7.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list, and English as the language of instruction is not enough outside the US or listed countries, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Please note language of instruction in English is not sufficient unless the university is located in the United States or on the list of countries below.

notes: JHU has no single graduate school: this record is the Krieger School of Arts and Sciences (physics, chemistry, math, biology, earth science). Whiting School of Engineering and School of Medicine programs carry their own overrides.
